correctness.rationale: For the odd-order splitting field, the character basis satisfies F_chi F_psi=N*1_{psi=chi^(-2)} F_(chi^(-1)). Its multiplier permutation T:chi↦chi^(-2) has fixed exactly chi^3=1 and no nontrivial 2-cycles (T²chi=chi entails chi³=1). Thus each nonfixed orbit is a cycle of length>=3, and commutator coefficients along it are arbitrary neighboring 2×2 determinants. The explicit cycle lemma covers even lengths by alternating independently chosen even vertices, odd lengths>=5 by a path of independent even vertices, and length3 separately; works even in characteristic2 and with zeros. Hence every vector in the known commutator span is a SINGLE bracket; dimension N-|A[3]|; width0 iff 3A=0, else1. Fresh exhaustive cycle-image checks covered every determinant target over F2 at lengths3–8 and over F3 at lengths3–5, not all groups.

value.rationale: An entire infinite family of explicitly posed commutator-width problems is solved by a nontrivial prescribed-minor surjectivity lemma and constructive Fourier witnesses.
